# This capture landed inside one of the undifferentiated windows: the 45 `Tp0*`
# keys answer only four values {-4.0, 0.0, 4.0, 40.0}, repeating in key order.
# Every one of them sits inside the plausible temperature range, so nothing
# except the collapse of the set says "this is not a temperature".

# Only DATA lines are kept. The probe also enumerated the full key table in this
# read and `diff` of the `KEY` lines between the two captures reported no
# difference, as well as no difference in any key's type or size: the table does
# not change during a window, only the sensor payloads. The tests rebuild the
# enumeration from the differentiated file.
